## Use case

Who needs this, and what task are they trying to complete?

## Proposed scope

Describe the change and what remains outside it. Reference the product definition
and roadmap task, if applicable.

## Acceptance criteria

- Describe an observable result.
- Describe relevant error or boundary cases.

## Dependencies and decisions

Link prerequisite work and identify any unresolved product or contract decisions.

## Alternatives

Describe other approaches considered and the trade-offs.
